config.heading: Built around the patient, not the product
config.subtitle: Three commitments that shape every consultation.

items.title: Specialist prescribers
items.description: Every prescription is written by a doctor on the specialist register, after reviewing your medical history.

items.title: A plan you can follow
items.description: You leave each consultation with a written plan: what was prescribed, how to take it and when we review it.

items.title: Pharmacy-dispensed
items.description: Medicines are dispensed by a licensed pharmacy and delivered in discreet, tracked packaging.

config.heading: Specialist care, plainly explained
config.content: Pilot Clinic is run by doctors who prescribe cannabis-based medicines for patients whose earlier treatments have not worked well enough. We explain the options in plain language, agree a plan with you and review it at regular follow-ups.

config.heading: From first question to first delivery
config.subtitle: Four steps, each with a named person responsible for it.

steps.title: Check eligibility
steps.description: Answer a short questionnaire about your condition and previous treatment.

steps.title: Meet your doctor
steps.description: A video consultation with a specialist who reviews your records.

steps.title: Receive your prescription
steps.description: If treatment is appropriate, your prescription goes to the pharmacy the same day.

steps.title: Tracked delivery
steps.description: The pharmacy dispenses and ships your medicine to your door.

config.heading: Before you start
config.subtitle: The questions patients ask most often before their first consultation.

items.question: Who can be prescribed medical cannabis?
items.answer: Adults with a diagnosed condition who have already tried licensed treatments without enough benefit. A specialist doctor decides whether a prescription is appropriate for you.

items.question: Do I need a referral from my GP?
items.answer: No. You can apply directly. With your consent we request a summary of your medical records so the doctor can review your history.

items.question: What does a consultation involve?
items.answer: A video appointment with a specialist doctor, usually 20 to 30 minutes. You discuss your condition, earlier treatment and what you hope to achieve.

items.question: How are prescriptions delivered?
items.answer: A licensed pharmacy dispenses your prescription and sends it by tracked courier in plain packaging. A signature is required on delivery.

config.heading: See whether you are eligible
config.subtitle: The questionnaire takes about fifteen minutes. A member of the clinical team replies within two working days.
config.footnote: Free to check. No obligation to book.

footerConfig.disclaimer: Medical cannabis is a regulated medicine. Availability and prescribing rules vary by jurisdiction. Consult a qualified medical professional. Keep out of reach of children.
